datasets.name: GEBCO Bathymetry
datasets.freshness_note: Static historical files on disk — this prototype does not ingest live satellite feeds. data_age_hours is wall-clock age of the file mtime, not an operational latency SLA.

datasets.name: GLORYS Ocean Data
datasets.note: GLORYS 0.083° daily-mean ocean currents. Surface uo/vo only.
datasets.freshness_note: Static historical files on disk — this prototype does not ingest live satellite feeds. data_age_hours is wall-clock age of the file mtime, not an operational latency SLA.

datasets.name: ERA5 Meteorological Data

datasets.freshness_note: Static historical files on disk — this prototype does not ingest live satellite feeds. data_age_hours is wall-clock age of the file mtime, not an operational latency SLA.

datasets.name: BYU MERS Iceberg Tracks

datasets.freshness_note: Static historical files on disk — this prototype does not ingest live satellite feeds. data_age_hours is wall-clock age of the file mtime, not an operational latency SLA.

datasets.name: Sentinel-1 SAR

datasets.freshness_note: Static historical files on disk — this prototype does not ingest live satellite feeds. data_age_hours is wall-clock age of the file mtime, not an operational latency SLA.
